messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GitHub Actions & Packages degraded — workflows failing during dependency install and OIDC token exchange; several release pipelines blocked (hotfix/release-urgent). Paging oncall: kim. https://www.githubstatus.com/ :rotating_light:

kim: Oncall here. seeing repeated failures at `npm ci` step and `OIDC` requests timing out. Are any customer-facing services impacted yet?

laura: Product: no current 5xxs on public APIs, but our S1 hotfix build is stuck in queued state. customers are asking for a patch ETA.

nikhil: Platform: Confirmed GH Actions runners hit intermittent 401/502 on api.github.com and github.pkg.dev. Hosted runners failing to fetch @redwood private packages. Likely upstream auth/registry problem.

amanda: Release: This blocks our entire release pipeline — cannot build or publish hotfix container. We do have yesterday's canary but it misses the fix. Options: local/bastion build + push, import commit into internal git mirror and run internal CI, or reconstruct node_modules from CI cache and build locally.

dante: SRE: For risk/traceability, prefer not to build from engineer laptops. We have a hardened bastion (ci-bastion-2) that can perform builds and pushes. Also we have an internal Buildkite fleet that doesn't rely on GH Packages if we import the repo. Which is faster?

kim: Fastest path to get code to prod with audit: 1) if we can import commit into internal gitlab mirror quickly (git bundle -> s3 -> gitlab import), trigger Buildkite which uses artifact-registry and our S3 cache; 2) else, bastion local build using S3 node_modules cache. Laura, do you have the commit available locally?

laura: I do. I'll make a git bundle and upload to s3 now. commands:

```
# on secure release laptop
git checkout hotfix/urgent-123
git rev-parse HEAD > /tmp/hotfix-sha
git bundle create /tmp/hotfix-urgent-123.bundle HEAD
aws s3 cp /tmp/hotfix-urgent-123.bundle s3://incident-uploads/1840000001/hotfix-urgent-123.bundle
aws s3 cp /tmp/hotfix-sha s3://incident-uploads/1840000001/hotfix-urgent-123.sha
```

nikhil: I'll import into gitlab.internal via the import API and spin up a Buildkite pipeline that uses `https://artifact-registry.internal.redwood/npm/` and tries to restore node_modules from `s3://ci-cache/`. If Buildkite fails to find a package in artifact-registry, we can fall back to the S3 artifact tarball `s3://artifact-backups/` for that package.

cache-bot: Cache lookup: node_modules snapshot for commit abcdef12 found at s3://ci-cache/node_modules-abcdef12.tgz (created 2026-03-14T02:10:00Z).

dante: Good. Security note: any build outside normal GH Actions requires SBOM, builder identity, and a short-lived exception ticket. Sec team please advise.

sec-bot: Sec process: if build runs on ci-bastion or Buildkite agents (org-owned), no exception needed but we still require SBOM upload and builder principal in deploy payload. If a laptop is used, file EXC with justification. Ensure SBOM is stored under s3://incidents/sboms/1840000001/ and attach path to deploy.

laura: Bundle uploaded to s3://incident-uploads/1840000001/hotfix-urgent-123.bundle and sha file present.

nikhil: Importing now to gitlab...

```
curl -X POST -H "PRIVATE-TOKEN: $GITLAB_TOKEN" -F "file=@/tmp/hotfix-urgent-123.bundle" https://gitlab.internal/api/v4/projects/321/import/repository
```

deploy-bot: GitLab import job queued (job id: 7701).

nikhil: Import finished. new ref available at gitlab.internal/redwood/hotfix/urgent-123. Triggering Buildkite pipeline (bk-run-3321) now. Pipeline configured to use artifact-registry and to restore node_modules from cache.

amanda: Buildkite started: step1 restore cache -> step2 npm ci (with local tarball fallback) -> step3 docker build -> step4 scan -> step5 push to GCR -> step6 deploy trigger. Logs show `@redwood/cli-utils` package missing from artifact-registry but present in s3://artifact-backups as tarball. Pipeline will `npm install` from file.

deploy-bot: Buildkite run bk-run-3321: docker build success. image: gcr.io/redwood-prod/hotfix:1840000001-bk-3321. container scan: no critical findings. SBOM generated at s3://incidents/sboms/1840000001/sbom-hotfix.json

dante: Triggering deploy. Include git provenance: original GitHub SHA (from laura), imported ref, builder agent id. Also include SBOM path and scan output.

nikhil: Deploy API call:

```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"image":"gcr.io/redwood-prod/hotfix:1840000001-bk-3321","env":"prod","git_provenance":{"original_sha":"abcdef12","imported_ref":"hotfix/urgent-123","import_method":"git-bundle-s3-import"},"sbom":"s3://incidents/sboms/1840000001/sbom-hotfix.json","builder":"buildkite-bk-3321"}' https://deployer.internal.redwood/api/v1/deploys
```

deploy-bot: Deployer accepted (deploy id: deploy-1840000001-01). Canary rollout: 3% -> 20% -> 60%

laura: Monitoring logs and metrics. No increase in errors; latency stable. Ramp to 100%.

cache-bot: Canary health OK. No regressions.

dante: Security/Audit: creating audit ticket AUDIT-1840000001 and linking SBOM and deploy id.

sec-bot: Audit ticket created: AUDIT-1840000001. No temporary exception required (build ran on org-owned Buildkite). Closing will occur after postmortem and artifact verification.

amanda: Customer comms: "Deploy completed using internal pipeline due to GitHub Actions/Packages outage. No customer impact observed. We're running a postmortem and will publish details." I'll prepare status update after PM review.

kim: Actions: (1) document git-bundle -> gitlab import -> Buildkite flow in incident runbook (assign: release team laura/nikhil); (2) eng-platform to improve artifact-registry mirror cadence and automated backups to S3 (assign: nikhil); (3) release to add a 'manual deploy' checklist to runbook; (4) CS to approve status post (assign: amanda). Handoff to dante for overnight watch.

dante: Taking overnight oncall. I'll validate there are no rollout regressions and confirm audit closure in AM.

incident-bot: Incident note appended: Hotfix deployed via internal import+Buildkite pipeline due to upstream GitHub Actions/Packages auth and registry degradation. Follow-ups: runbook additions, mirror automation, daily artifact snapshots.

kim: Thanks team. Closing pager. :white_check_mark:

status-bot: Postmortem scheduled for 48 hours. Owners: laura (release runbook), nikhil (mirror automation), dante (SRE follow-up), sec-bot (audit)
